title: A residually finite analogue of Kegel's theorem on splitting automorphisms
summary: Thompson proved that every finite group admitting a fixed-point-free automorphism of prime order is nilpotent, and Kegel showed that the same conclusion holds for finite groups admitting a splitting automorphism of prime order. Motivated by these results, Sozutov asked whether a \(p'\)-group admitting a splitting automorphism of prime order is locally nilpotent if \[ \langle g, g^\varphi, \dots, g^{\varphi^{p-1}} \rangle \] is nilpotent for every \(g \in G\), \cite[Problem 10.59]{kourovka21}.
